description: We are HVB Horizon, a student team from Hatipzade Veli Başer Anatolian Imam Hatip High School joining NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are passionate about space, artificial intelligence, coding, robotics, and innovation. Our goal is to develop creative solutions using NASA's open data. We welcome curious, creative, and motivated teammates skilled in programming, data analysis, design, research, and problem-solving. Together, we explore, learn, and innovate!

details:
Project Details – HVB Horizon: Silent Explorers

HVB Horizon – Silent Explorers is an interactive educational web platform designed to bring NASA's historic space missions and their scientific legacy to life for students aged 10–15.

How does our project work?

Our platform explores five remarkable NASA missions: InSight, Opportunity, Sojourner, Ingenuity, and Apollo.

Instead of presenting technical information through traditional explanations, we let spacecraft tell their own stories. Through engaging first-person narratives, students discover each mission's journey, challenges, achievements, and scientific contributions.

The experience combines storytelling, visual presentations, and interactive quizzes. Students explore the missions, learn about their scientific discoveries, and reinforce their knowledge through engaging activities.

Benefits and intended impact

Our project makes space science accessible, entertaining, and meaningful for young learners. We aim to inspire scientific curiosity, develop research skills, encourage critical thinking, and motivate students to explore space technology.

By highlighting the achievements of historic missions, we demonstrate how past discoveries continue to shape our understanding of the universe and contribute to future scientific progress.

Development process and research

Our five student researchers each focused on a different NASA mission. We gathered information from official NASA resources, reliable scientific references, and the Gemini AI tool. Our team reviewed and transformed the collected information into age-appropriate educational stories.

The platform combines modern web development, visual learning, interactive assessment, and creative storytelling to deliver an engaging digital learning experience.

Creativity and design considerations

Our project's unique approach is giving NASA's spacecraft their own voices. Rather than treating retired space hardware as forgotten technology, we present each spacecraft as a storyteller sharing its scientific journey with the next generation.

Throughout development, we prioritized scientific accuracy, age-appropriate content, accessibility, clear communication, user-friendly design, and student engagement.

Our vision

We believe that space exploration is part of humanity's shared scientific heritage. By connecting historical missions with innovative digital storytelling, HVB Horizon aims to inspire future scientists, engineers, and explorers.

Because even when a spacecraft's mission ends, its scientific story continues.
